latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of SaaS Acquisition Prep Coach.

- Guides SaaS founders through the acquisition process, from long-term prep to post-LOI execution.
- Covers essential topics: data room setup, key metrics (NRR, GRR, CAC payback, customer concentration), contract and cap table cleanup, and valuation drivers.
- Explains phases (pre-process, inbound interest, LOI/diligence, pre-close) and what buyers look for.
- Outlines buyer types (strategic, PE rollup, aggregators) and typical deal structures.
- Triggered by phrases related to SaaS exits, M&A, data room, and acquisition terms; avoids acquihires and pure fundraising.
- Designed to maximize founder leverage and exit value by front-loading preparation.
